name: Rachel Armitage

bio.statement: Oregon Capital Chronicle's 2026 primary voter guide says Armitage briefly served as an appointed state senator after Sen. Betsy Johnson resigned.
bio.excerpt: briefly served as an appointed state senator

bio.statement: In her voters' pamphlet statement, Armitage lists her occupation as K-12 education, with a background as state senator, program officer at the Oregon Community Foundation, Reed College advancement and early childhood educator.
bio.excerpt: Occupation: K-12 Education Occupational Background: State Senator • North Coast Program Officer, Oregon Community Foundation • Reed College Advancement • Early Childhood Educator
